info.title: FINN API
info.description: Mobile-first financial investment agent. Contract: docs/CONTRACT.md

get.description:
Cached report if built; otherwise starts a background build and returns status=building with progress
(the client polls every 3 s). Mock fixtures only when there is no ingested database at all (fresh checkout).
Real ledger numbers once any LLM call has been made; illustrative mock until then.
Live cloud-IP check: can THIS server reach BSE, screener.in and Yahoo? (3 cheap requests, no LLM.)

value.title: Value
value.description: vol_ratio, pct_1d, or filing score depending on kind

links.title: Links
links.description: Web sources used for the bio (push-side enrichment)

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: 'mock' = the API is serving illustrative fixtures (no ingested database). The UI must NOT label mock data LIVE.

vol_avg_20d.title: Vol Avg 20D
vol_avg_20d.description: Mean volume of the previous 20 sessions (excludes as_of)

said_in.title: Said In
said_in.description: Period of the call where it was promised

is_sample.title: Is Sample
is_sample.description: True for illustrative fixture data; the UI must badge it SAMPLE. False only for research built from real documents.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Human-readable build steps, shown while building

gaps.title: Gaps
gaps.description: Explicit missing-data notes, e.g. 'No Q1 FY26 transcript'
